title: Prepositions for technical English
explanationRu: Предлоги лучше учить готовыми связками: work with, work on, connect to, listen on a port, deploy to a server, run in a container, communicate over UART.

examples.en: The service runs in a container.

exercises.question: I connect ___ the server over SSH.
The application runs ___ a Docker container.
Я работаю над VPN-проектом.
acceptedAnswers: I work on a VPN project.
I am working on a VPN project.

exercises.question: Сервис развёрнут на VPS.
acceptedAnswers: The service is deployed to a VPS.
The service is deployed on a VPS.
exercises.explanation: Обе формулировки употребляются; to акцентирует развёртывание, on — расположение.
